Subject: DPA redlines and SCCs — initial pass

Sean,

Thanks for sending the draft DPA. We've run this past our legal team and have three primary asks at this stage:

1) Clarify processor/processor roles for our EU patient data flows — we need explicit subprocessor routing and a short list of onshore exceptions.
2) SCCs: we prefer the EU Commission Annex implementation language; can you confirm Redwood will accept Annex A + the routing exhibit?
3) Hosting surcharge: because of required UK/EU-only hosting for certain workloads, procurement needs an estimated monthly surcharge and evidence of KMS options.

I've attached our annotated redlines (Novus_DPA_proposed_redlines_20260810.docx). Can we set a quick call to align before legal redlines go to commercial?

Best,
Amanda
Head of Privacy, Novus Health

Amanda,

Appreciate the detailed pass and the redlines. Quick notes before a call:

- Processor roles: Laura (privacy lead) and I will map the subprocessor matrix against the routing exhibit and provide a one-page table showing which services process EU data. That should address your onshore exception ask.
- SCCs: Redwood can accept the Commission's Annex flow; we'll attach the SCCs_Amendment_v3.pdf and mark the routing exhibit as binding. Legal wants one small edit to the liability paragraph — I'll surface that on the call.
- Hosting surcharge: Ben in Commercial is looped to run a quick model. Ben, can you confirm a ballpark monthly surcharge range (EUR) and whether KMS-managed keys (customer-managed) are an option for Novus?

Proposed call: Mon 17 Aug 10:00 UK / 05:00 PT — 30 min. If that doesn't work, suggest Tue 11:00 UK.

We can also push the annotated doc back with redlines before the call if preferable.

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Privacy & Compliance

Team,

High-level commercial answers for Amanda's procurement note:

- Hosting surcharge estimate (EU-only / guaranteed region tenancy): EUR 1,500–2,500 per month depending on committed throughput. I'll confirm based on the expected token volume if Novus can share projected monthly tokens.
- KMS: Customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted API we offer a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) integration on dedicated contracts only. That said, we can scope a hybrid (customer keys for EU buckets) — will need security signoff.
- I'll prepare a short cost-impact sheet (Cost_Impact_Sheet_Novus.xlsx) and share before the call.

Ben
